stem.text: A spring has an unstretched length of $0.30\,\text{m}$ and a spring constant of $400\,\text{N m}^{-1}$. An object is suspended from the spring and the spring is deformed within its limit of proportionality. The new length of the spring is $0.50\,\text{m}$.
What is the elastic potential energy stored in the spring?
